0.content:
## BeerTracker load test analysis
Requests tagged by the k6 driver (`load/script.js`) with
`x-dynatrace-test: VU=<vu>;SI=k6;LTN=<RUN_NAME>;LSN=<script>;TSN=<step>;`.
Pick a **Run** (`LTN` = `RUN_NAME`) and **Script** (`LSN`); set the timeframe to cover the run.
Needs the header in Grail: a request attribute named `x-dynatrace-test` capturing the full header value, **or** request-header capture for `x-dynatrace-test`.
Durations are server-side span durations, not k6's client-side `http_req_duration`. Steps named `setup_*` come from k6 `setup()` (VU 0) and are excluded from the VU counts.

1.title: Requests
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize Requests = count()

2.title: Failure rate %
2.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize Failure_rate = 100.0 * countIf((request.is_failed == true or http.response.status_code >= 400)) / count()

3.title: p95 response time
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95)

4.title: Max VUs seen
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| filter VU > 0
| summarize VUs = countDistinct(VU)

5.title: Throughput (req/s)
5.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize n = count(), s = min(start_time), e = max(start_time)
| fieldsAdd rps = n / (toLong(e - s) / 1000000000.0)
| fields rps

6.title: Requests per step
6.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| makeTimeseries Requests = count(), by:{TSN}, interval:30s

7.title: Response time p50 / p95 / p99
7.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| makeTimeseries p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99), interval:30s

8.title: Failed requests per step
8.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| makeTimeseries Failures = countIf((request.is_failed == true or http.response.status_code >= 400)), by:{TSN}, interval:30s

9.title: Active VUs (distinct VU ids per 30 s)
9.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| filter VU > 0
| summarize VUs = countDistinct(VU), by:{time = bin(start_time, 30s)}
| sort time asc

10.title: Per step: the k6 summary, server side
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countIf((request.is_failed == true or http.response.status_code >= 400)),
    avg = avg(duration), p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95),
    p99 = percentile(duration, 99), max = max(duration), by:{TSN}
| fieldsAdd `Failure %` = round(100.0 * Failures / Requests, decimals:2)
| sort p95 desc

11.title: Status codes per step
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize Requests = count(), by:{TSN, http.request.method, http.response.status_code}
| sort TSN asc, http.response.status_code asc

12.title: Services and endpoints hit by the test
12.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize Requests = count(), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{Service = entityName(dt.entity.service), endpoint.name}
| sort Requests desc

13.title: Where the time goes: downstream services in test traces
13.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| fields trace.id
| dedup trace.id
| join [fetch spans | filter span.kind == "server" or span.kind == "client" or span.kind == "internal"], on:{trace.id}, fields:{dt.entity.service, span.kind, duration}
| summarize Spans = count(), total = sum(duration), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{Service = entityName(dt.entity.service), span.kind}
| sort total desc

14.title: Slowest requests (open trace.id in Distributed Tracing)
14.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter LTN == $Run and in(LSN, array($Script))
| fields start_time, TSN, VU, duration, http.response.status_code, Service = entityName(dt.entity.service), trace.id
| sort duration desc
| limit 50

15.title: Run comparison: p95 per step across all runs in the timeframe
15.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "server"
| fieldsAdd hdr = coalesce(`request_attribute.x-dynatrace-test`, `http.request.header.x-dynatrace-test`)
| filter isNotNull(hdr) and contains(hdr, "SI=k6")
| parse hdr, "'VU=' INT:VU ';SI=' LD:SI ';LTN=' LD:LTN ';LSN=' LD:LSN ';TSN=' LD:TSN ';'"
| filter in(LSN, array($Script))
| summarize start = min(start_time), Requests = count(), p95 = percentile(duration, 95),
    `Failure %` = round(100.0 * countIf((request.is_failed == true or http.response.status_code >= 400)) / count(), decimals:2), by:{TSN, LTN}
| sort TSN asc, start asc
